note: Positive and defeating cases that run from a complete GitHub issue body through scripts/sovticket/yamlblock.py and, for a positive case, on into contracts/issue-metadata.schema.json. The metadata corpus beside this one starts from already-parsed JSON, so it can only judge the schema; nothing crossed the reader. That gap let the schema declare an asks shape the reader could not parse, and issue #67 - the one live story ticket - failed the contract check while every fixture passed. A case here is a whole crossing: bytes a person could paste into GitHub in at one end, and either declared metadata or a named refusal out at the other.

cases.proves: A story body written the way contracts/issue-metadata.schema.json declares asks - a block sequence whose items are mappings of of and adjustment - parses from the issue body and satisfies the schema. Until this case existed the corpus fed pre-parsed JSON, so the schema could admit a shape no real ticket body could reach.
cases.body:
```yaml
issue_schema: soveraeign-ticket/v1
tags:
  - "kind:story"
  - "village:reach-and-motion"
  - "horizon:now-to-next"
  - "effect:record-local"

leans_on: ["#6", "#7", "#11", "#12", "#13"]

  - of: "#11"
    adjustment: "give a human operator a continuous identity the record can attribute a request to"
  - of: "#30"
    adjustment: "realize the judgement-request post as a Human Binding surface"
scenario: null

dependency_channels:
  produces: [observation]
  consumes: [record-spine, trust-control]
```

cases.proves: A repeated key inside one sequence item would silently drop an ask. Duplicates are refused inside a sequence item exactly as they are at the top level.
cases.body:
```yaml
kind: story
asks:
  - of: "#11"
    of: "#30"
```

# Title

Prose follows the block.

cases.proves: The reader admits one level of mapping inside a sequence item. A deeper key is refused by name rather than approximated into the level above it.
cases.refuses: nested key outside a nested mapping
cases.body:

```yaml
kind: story
asks:

    adjustment: "give a human operator a continuous identity"
      note: "an extra level the contract never declared"
```
